Predicates:
FinancialAid(x) ::: x receives financial aid.
ProveHardship(x) ::: x proves economic hardship.
SingleParentFamily(x) ::: x lives in a single-parent family.
FewResources(x) ::: x has few resources available.
LivesInFamily(x, y) ::: x lives in family y.
WorksOutOfWork(y) ::: y is out of work.
ApplyingToTest(x) ::: x is applying to take the GRE test.
Premises:
∃x (SingleParentFamily(x)) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
∃y (WorksOutOfWork(y)) ::: Tom's dad has been out of work.
∃z (FewResources(z)) ::: Tom has few resources available.
LivesInFamily(Tom, x) ∧ SingleParentFamily(x) ::: Tom lives in a single-parent family.
WorksOutOfWork(y) ∧ LivesInFamily(Tom, x) ::: Tom's dad has been out of work.
FewResources(z) ∧ LivesInFamily(Tom, x) ::: Tom has few resources available.
ApplyingToTest(Tom) ::: Tom is applying to take the GRE test.
Conclusion:
FinancialAid(Tom) ::: ETS provides financial aid to Tom.
